days.title: How Photos Capture Light
days.learning_objective: Maps represent our world and help us navigate.
learning_objectives: Identify and define key map elements (title, legend, scale, compass rose).
Use a map scale to estimate distances between two points.
Locate specific places on a map using coordinates (latitude and longitude).

days.title: How Movies Create Motion
days.learning_objective: Continents are Earth's largest landmasses.
learning_objectives: Identify and name the seven continents.
Locate the continents on a world map or globe.
Describe key geographical features of each continent.
Understand the relative size and position of each continent.
Compare and contrast the characteristics of different continents.

days.title: How TV Shows Pictures
days.learning_objective: Countries are political divisions with unique cultures and governments.
learning_objectives: Identify and name at least 10 different countries on a world map.
Describe the basic forms of government in at least 3 different countries.
Explain one unique cultural tradition from a country of their choice.

days.title: Invisible Waves Carrying Sound
days.learning_objective: Cities concentrate people, resources, and opportunities.
learning_objectives: Identify the key factors that attract people and resources to cities.
Explain the basic principles of city planning and urban development.
Analyze the economic, social, and environmental impacts of cities.

days.title: Talking Across Distances
days.learning_objective: Villages are small communities often close to nature.
learning_objectives: Define 'village' and identify its key characteristics.
Describe different types of villages and their geographical locations.
Explain the importance of community and nature in village life.

days.title: How Medicine Heals
days.learning_objective: Homes provide shelter and reflect cultural values.
learning_objectives: Identify diverse types of homes across different cultures and climates.
Explain how homes provide shelter and protection from the environment.
Describe how cultural values and traditions influence home design and construction.

days.title: Training Your Immune System
days.learning_objective: Families come in many forms and provide support and belonging.
learning_objectives: Define the concept of 'family' in broad and inclusive terms.
Identify different types of family structures and their characteristics.
Explain the importance of support and belonging within a family unit.

days.title: Fixing the Body From Inside
days.learning_objective: Communities are groups of people who share space and values.
learning_objectives: Define 'community' and identify its key characteristics.
Recognize different types of communities and their unique purposes.
Explain the importance of shared values and collaboration within a community.

days.title: Why Clean Matters
days.learning_objective: Cultures are shared ways of life passed through generations.
learning_objectives: Define 'culture' and identify its key components (beliefs, values, customs).
Describe how cultures are transmitted across generations through various means.
Compare and contrast at least three different cultures, recognizing their similarities and differences.

days.title: How Food Becomes You
days.learning_objective: Traditions connect us to our past and to each other.
learning_objectives: Define 'tradition' and identify different types of traditions.
Explain how traditions connect people to their past and to each other.
Compare and contrast traditions from different cultures around the world.

days.title: What Happens When You Sleep
days.learning_objective: Celebrations mark important moments and bring people together.
learning_objectives: Identify the common elements found in celebrations across different cultures.
Explain the significance of specific celebrations in at least three different cultures.
Create a unique celebration incorporating elements from various cultural traditions.

days.title: Why We Dream
days.learning_objective: Holidays honor events, people, or seasonal changes.
learning_objectives: Identify the three primary reasons for holidays: events, people, or seasonal changes.
Compare and contrast holiday traditions from different cultures.
Explain the historical significance of a chosen holiday.

days.title: Where Food Comes From
days.learning_objective: Food provides energy and is central to culture and connection.
learning_objectives: Identify the main food groups and their primary functions in the body.
Explain how food provides energy and supports physical activity.
Describe how different cultures use food in celebrations and traditions.

days.title: How Farming Changed Everything
days.learning_objective: Cooking transforms ingredients into nourishing meals.
learning_objectives: Identify and use common kitchen tools and equipment safely.
Demonstrate basic knife skills, such as chopping, dicing, and mincing.
Prepare a simple recipe from start to finish, following instructions accurately.

days.title: How Animals Are Related
days.learning_objective: Farming produces food and has shaped human civilization.
learning_objectives: Identify the main crops grown in their local area.
Explain the basic steps involved in planting and harvesting crops.
Describe the historical significance of farming on human societies.

days.title: Why We Keep Pets
days.learning_objective: Tools extend human capabilities and solve practical problems.
learning_objectives: Identify common tools and their specific functions.
Explain how tools extend human capabilities.
Demonstrate how tools solve practical problems.

days.title: The Most Successful Animals
days.learning_objective: Clothing protects us and expresses identity and culture.
learning_objectives: Define the two primary functions of clothing: protection and expression.
Identify examples of how clothing reflects cultural identity across different societies.
Explain how environmental factors influence clothing choices.
Compare and contrast different types of fabrics and their properties.

days.title: Birds Are Dinosaurs
days.learning_objective: Shelter protects us from weather and provides security.
learning_objectives: Identify the three primary functions of shelter: protection from weather, provision of security, and support of daily activities.
Compare and contrast different types of shelter based on climate, materials, and cultural influences.
Design and construct a model of a shelter that addresses specific environmental challenges and needs.

days.title: Life Under Water
days.learning_objective: Transportation moves people and goods across distances.
learning_objectives: Identify various modes of transportation and their uses.
Explain the impact of transportation on trade and cultural exchange.
Describe the historical evolution of transportation technologies.

days.title: Animals Like Us
days.learning_objective: Boats allowed humans to cross water and explore new lands.
learning_objectives: Identify at least three different types of boats and their uses.
Explain how boats have facilitated exploration and trade.
Design and build a simple boat that floats.

days.title: Cold-Blooded Survivors
days.learning_objective: Bicycles provide efficient, human-powered transportation.
learning_objectives: Identify the main components of a bicycle and their functions.
Explain how bicycles contribute to sustainable transportation and reduce carbon emissions.
Demonstrate basic bicycle safety practices, including helmet use and hand signals.

days.title: Living in Two Worlds
days.learning_objective: Trains move large numbers of people and goods efficiently.
learning_objectives: Identify different types of trains and their functions.
Explain the basic principles of how trains move and operate.
Describe the historical impact of trains on society and trade.

days.title: How Plants Make Food
days.learning_objective: Cars provide personal mobility and shaped modern cities.
learning_objectives: Identify key milestones in the history of automobile development.
Explain the impact of cars on urban planning and societal development.
Analyze the environmental impact of cars and potential solutions for sustainable transportation.

days.title: Giants That Live for Centuries
days.learning_objective: Bridges connect separated places and overcome obstacles.
learning_objectives: Identify and describe at least three different types of bridges.
Explain the basic principles of bridge design, including load and support.
Build a simple model bridge using provided materials.

days.title: Why Flowers Exist
days.learning_objective: Roads enable travel and trade between communities.
learning_objectives: Identify the different types of roads and their purposes.
Explain how roads facilitate trade and communication between communities.
Describe the basic steps involved in building a road.

days.title: Why Plants Make Fruit
days.learning_objective: Money facilitates exchange and stores value.
learning_objectives: Define money and its key functions: medium of exchange and store of value.
Explain how money facilitates trade and economic activity.
Identify different forms of money throughout history and today.

days.title: What Counts as a Vegetable
days.learning_objective: Trade allows people to exchange goods and services.
learning_objectives: Define trade as the exchange of goods and services.
Identify examples of trade in everyday life.
Explain how trade benefits both parties involved.

days.title: The Hidden Kingdom
days.learning_objective: Jobs provide income and contribute to society.
learning_objectives: Identify at least three different types of jobs and their functions.
Explain how jobs provide income and contribute to society.
Describe the skills and education needed for a chosen career.

days.title: Tiny Life Everywhere
days.learning_objective: Teamwork achieves goals that individuals cannot reach alone.
learning_objectives: Define teamwork and identify its key components.
Apply effective communication strategies within a team setting.
Demonstrate techniques for resolving conflicts and building consensus.
Explain how diverse skills contribute to team success.
Develop a plan for collaborative problem-solving.

days.title: Not Quite Alive
days.learning_objective: Leadership guides groups toward shared goals.
learning_objectives: Define leadership and identify its key components.
Analyze different leadership styles and their effectiveness in various situations.
Develop communication and collaboration skills essential for effective leadership.

days.title: How Nature Connects
days.learning_objective: Art expresses human creativity and emotion.
learning_objectives: Identify different art forms and styles.
Express emotions and ideas through visual art.
Understand the basic elements of art (color, line, shape, texture, space).
Create original artwork using various materials.
